card.title: Xbox One Controller Buttons are not responding to being pressed repair

source.title: Xbox One Controller Buttons are not responding to being pressed repair

claims.statement: Clean the PCB carbon tracks and membrane pads; if still dead, check continuity from the diode footprint to the IO expander test pad—early revisions can lose vias spontaneously.

procedure: Check continuity to the IO expander; repair broken vias.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
